headline: JBL announced an $1,800 party speaker that uses AI to strip the vocals from any song so people can sing karaoke over it.
score_reason: Pool score kept; niche consumer product, untested by the reviewer.
importance_line: Karaoke fans and party hosts are the buyers; the vocal feature is untested on this model by Gizmodo, and the price is high.
summary: Gizmodo reports that JBL has unveiled the PartyBox Ultimate 2, a 120-pound, 1,500-watt speaker priced at $1,800 that uses AI to remove vocals from any track at the press of a button. Gizmodo's writer says he has used the same feature on another JBL product but not on this speaker, which is on preorder and ships from 25 Oct 2026.
notes: Reviewer has not tested this model.
